title: Two kinds of stereoisomer
caption: E- and Z-but-2-ene differ in which side of the rigid C=C the methyl groups sit. (R)- and (S)-butan-2-ol differ at a chiral centre and are non-superimposable mirror images. In each pair the atoms are joined in the same order.
alt: E- and Z-but-2-ene, and the two enantiomers of butan-2-ol with wedge and hash bonds.
description: E-but-2-ene: methyl groups on opposite sides of the double bond.
Z-but-2-ene: methyl groups on the same side.
(R)-butan-2-ol and (S)-butan-2-ol: mirror images at the carbon bearing OH.
